text:
Ava: Rolling a canary rate cap to 10rpm for model-prod route — planning 5% canary for 30m. Who can flip emergency-disable if latency spikes? Need audit path + contact.
Riley: Oncall SRE can flip, but we prefer 2 approvals if this crosses regions. pinging @oncall-sre
Ken: Who currently holds the hotkey? infra-admins or prod-ops?
Maya: Last time infra-admins had it. Can we require prod-lead + oncall to flip for safety?
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started (id=cr-5298) -> 5% -> config: ratecap=10rpm
Riley: Suggest guardrails: auto-rollback if p95 latency > 300ms OR error rate > 1% sustained for 3m.
Ava: Ack. Also need exact disable command + where the operation will be audited.
Ken: ```sudo feature-toggle disable --scope model-prod --reason "emergency: latency spike" --audit-id=CR-5298```
Maya: Only users in group `prod-ops` can run that currently. If needed I'll add prod-lead to ACL for this window.
Riley: I'll temporarily add prod-lead + oncall-sre to prod-ops ACL and log the change.
oncall-sre: I'm on pager, watching the canary. If I flip I will post SIEM link and trace id.
Ava: If anyone flips please post: (1) who flipped (2) command output screenshot (3) SIEM audit link and (4) brief rationale. Ping #incidents and this thread. :thumbsup:
